Feds, Ontario to sign deal reducing regulatory burden on Ring of Fire, other projects
item.description: TORONTO — Ottawa and Ontario are set to finalize a deal Thursday that will reduce the regulatory burden on large projects, including the road to the Ring of Fire, The Canadian Press has learned.

item.title: Residents unconvinced by Vancouver's plan to replace Downtown Eastside rooming houses
item.description: VANCOUVER — Downtown Eastside resident Brian O'Donnell lives in a single-room occupancy hotel in Chinatown, although he says it's not really a home. "It's livable," said O'Donnell, who added that he felt like a "house mother" to fellow tenants.

item.title: Federal help with infrastructure is critical to trade, B.C. Premier Eby says
item.description: VANCOUVER — Federal government investment in provincial transportation infrastructure is crucial to avoid long-term impacts on cross-Canada trade and companies' willingness to work in British Columbia, Premier David Eby says.

item.title: Pulitzer Prize-winning correspondent Peter Arnett, who reported from Vietnam and Gulf War, has died
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Peter Arnett, the Pulitzer Prize-winning reporter who spent decades dodging bullets and bombs to bring the world eyewitness accounts of war from the rice paddies of Vietnam to the deserts of Iraq, has died at 91.

item.title: Trump gives a partisan prime-time address insisting the economy is stronger than many voters feel

item.title: Making lawyers swear Oath of Allegiance to monarch unconstitutional: Alberta court
item.description: EDMONTON — Alberta's top court has ruled that requiring prospective lawyers to swear the Oath of Allegiance to the reigning monarch is unconstitutional and infringes on religious freedom.

item.title: Second-degree murder charge laid in death of Onigaming First Nation man
item.description: KENORA — Provincial Police in Ontario say a 23-year-old man has been charged with second-degree murder in the death of a man from Onigaming First Nation.

item.title: US announces massive package of arms sales to Taiwan valued at more than $10 billion
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The Trump administration has announced a massive package of arms sales to Taiwan valued at more than $10 billion that includes medium-range missiles, howitzers and drones, a move that is sure to infuriate China.

item.title: Investigators seek older video that might show the Brown campus shooter days before the attack
item.description: PROVIDENCE, R.I. (AP) — Authorities searching for a shooter who attacked students Saturday at Brown University are asking for tips from people who might have video of the shooter potentially casing the area the week before.
